name: cv-studio
description: Tailored, fact-checked CV generator driven by a Claude Code command

scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.smoke: node build-cv-html.mjs --test && node verify-cv-facts.mjs tests/baseline-servicenow.html && node generate-pdf.mjs tests/baseline-servicenow.html output/_smoke.pdf --format=letter
